message.content:
(1) Overall layout structure: **DIFF** (Image 1 uses a centered modal overlay on a file browser; Image 2 is a full-page wizard view with a left sidebar).
(2) Information architecture: **DIFF** (Image 1 shows a simple list of drives with warning icons; Image 2 shows drives as cards with progress bars and includes an expanded "Recovery queue" section not present in Image 1).
(3) Color palette family: **MATCH** (Both use a light theme with primary blues, neutral grays, and white backgrounds).
(4) Typography scale: **MATCH** (Both use bold headings for sections, standard weight for body text, and smaller gray text for metadata/labels).
(5) Control geometry: **DIFF** (Image 1 uses a compact list with radio buttons; Image 2 uses tall, rounded cards with horizontal progress bars for storage info).
(6) Primary CTA placement: **DIFF** (Image 1 places the "Save" CTA at the bottom right of the modal; Image 2 places the "Recover" CTA at the bottom right of the main page).

VERDICT: STRUCTURALLY_DIVERGENT. The re-implementation transforms the compact modal-based selection into a full-page wizard with significantly different component geometry and additional information architecture layers.
